top_signals.title: Treasury yields hit multi-year highs as investors await key wholesale inflation data
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields moved higher on Thursday as traders await the release of U.S. wholesale inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Intesa Investors Back Share Issue to Finance Paschi Offer
top_signals.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo SpA shareholders approved the issuance of new shares to finance the €35.4 billion ($41.2 billion) takeover bid for Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena SpA, bringing Chief Executive Officer Carlo Messina a step closer to a deal that would reshape Italy’s financial landscape.
